_comment: Row 793 round b. The correctness lens (bd-review-wt/row793-cx9-local/.review/VERDICT-correctness.md) ran these five by hand against round a's gate: M1/M2 CAUGHT, M3 ESCAPED (case-fold unpinned), M4 ESCAPED (a real arbitrary-file-serve bypass), M5 PASS.
